architecture: Small catalog state helper and shared finite MEDIA_ORIGINS are appropriate. Existing controller/coordinator are unchanged. Server continuation inputs permit only pages 1/2, each using existing 50-row, 10-choice, timeout, byte, and redirect limits. Client needs search/request generation identity rather than country/page alone.
complexity: Scope and dependency footprint are restrained. A monotonically increasing search generation plus guarded completion/error/finally handling is sufficient to fix the main race without altering playback coordination. Preserve useful existing regression coverage and add deterministic delayed-response cases.
correctness: Normal append, URL/UUID deduplication, retry, selection marker, audio source and playback preservation are supported by code and passing tests. Reproduced stale page acceptance after a fresh same-country initial result: receive returned continuation and rows became fresh-initial plus stale-page. Reproduced inaccurate scanned range for a single provider row: UI claimed rows 1–50. These are implementation defects, separate from coverage/host evidence gaps.

findings.evidence: Focused Node reproduction against dist/station-list.js produced disposition continuation and rows [fresh-initial, stale-page] after initial FR, replacement initial FR, then old continuation FR page1. Source confirms promise completion is unguarded.
findings.issue: An old continuation can mutate a newly reset search for the same country. More captures country/page only; a new initial result clears catalog state but does not invalidate the pending callback. Example: FR page 1 pending, fresh FR initial arrives (or FR→GB→FR), old FR page 1 resolves and passes the country/page guard. It appends obsolete rows and advances the fresh search to page 2; old errors can similarly replace its summary.
findings.requested_change: Invalidate outstanding More work on each new initial search using a generation/request token; guard success, error and finally against that token, and validate response country/page against the actual request. Add delayed-response regression tests for same-country reset and FR→GB→FR, including stale failures and current pending state.

findings.evidence: Focused Node reproduction with searchedCount:1 and one station displayed after scanning provider rows 1–50.
findings.issue: The displayed inspected range ignores searchedCount and always claims a complete 50-row window. A one-row initial response says provider rows 1–50; an empty continuation can claim rows through 100 despite inspecting no rows in that page.
findings.requested_change: Track actual inspected rows/ranges from searchedCount, or explicitly label these numbers as requested windows rather than inspected rows. Cover short/empty pages in summary assertions.

findings.evidence: Coverage document and Implement report explicitly disclose these limitations.
findings.issue: US has zero accepted candidates, contrary to the approved minimum; ES is explicitly BLOCKED, DE/JP are unverified catalog entries, and owner host QA/audio evidence is absent.
findings.requested_change: Keep acceptance blocked; route US coverage/scope decision to Foreman/owner and obtain required independent/owner evidence. Do not interpret the passing automated suite as eight-country audible coverage.

requirements: Reviewed exact HEAD candidate and approved PRODUCT/TECH hashes; both match packet. Most bounded browsing behavior is implemented, but stale search-generation rejection is incomplete. Acceptance 1 is unmet: US has no newly accepted candidate; honest US/ES gaps and DE/JP unverified catalog evidence are documented. Owner host/audio evidence required by acceptance 4 remains BLOCKED. A US scope change requires Foreman/owner approval, not implicit reviewer acceptance.
security: No arbitrary URL tool input, proxy, wildcard media origin or widened connectDomains introduced. Server, client and discovery CSP use one finite origin list; server redirects remain rejected and user/provider names use text nodes. Exact-UUID overrides retain signed click attribution. Added origins have bounded direct-probe evidence documented, but host CSP/playability is explicitly unverified and cannot be accepted as passed. Prior URL-normalization behavior remains unchanged.
tests: Ran npm test against exact candidate: TypeScript/esbuild completed and all 31 tests passed, zero failed. Ran bounded Node catalog reproduction showing same-country stale response acceptance and one-row scan overstatement. Existing delivered-browser test covers successful More while playing; it immediately resolves requests and does not cover delayed continuation after reset, old failures/finalizers, or return-to-same-country races. No live network or host/audibility verification was performed by Review; coverage probe observations are Implement evidence and await independent Verify.
